historical_self_valuation.method: historical own enterprise value divided by then-known actual TTM GAAP revenues; 4 disclosure dates, not peers, not future DCF

historical_self_valuation.explanation: (median * actual TTM revenue + corporate ordinary cash minus current interest-bearing debt) / 256.2M A+B economic shares, not shares weighted average
